limitations: Ordered fresh bind then fresh volume; one trial each, not repeated causal proof.
Actual bucket policy and strict persistence unverified; source defaults are not live policy proof.
4KiB prefix1 raw-store diagnostic, not the full production geometry.
Nested/concurrent/repeated-label stages overlap and cannot be summed as exclusive work.

Partial 2s sampled phase windows rely on uncalibrated guest/host UTC alignment; wall enclosure differs from monotonic elapsed by up to sub-millisecond drift. Outer windows include adjacent phases and overlap.
Cgroup memory is not process RSS; throttled time is aggregate, not exclusive wall duration.
Bind VirtioFS data incompletely covered by guest io.stat; named-volume guest counts are not host physical NVMe IOPS.
Docker operation counts unavailable; no per-PUT block amplification factor claimed.
Successful PUT empty response body_dropped is expected unpolled-response coverage, not a failure.
Observed HTTP dispatch-to-headers includes scheduling/network/service waits, not exclusive CPU/disk attribution.
Original RustFS network check coverage remains explicitly incomplete in health receipts.
